title: App Store Connect API 4.4.1 release notes

abstract.text: Update your server-side code to use new features, and test your code against API changes.

paragraphs.text: App Store Connect API version 4.4.1 provides resources that enable you to automate actions you take in App Store Connect.

listItems.text: Manage in-app purchase metadata as discrete versions. Use `POST-v1-inAppPurchaseVersions` to create a new version, `GET-v1-inAppPurchaseVersions-_id_` to read a version, and `GET-v2-inAppPurchases-_id_-versions` to list all versions for an in-app purchase. Each version exposes its own localizations and review screenshot through `GET-v1-inAppPurchaseVersions-_id_-localizations` and `GET-v1-inAppPurchaseVersions-_id_-image`.

Manage subscription metadata as discrete versions. Use `POST-v1-subscriptionVersions` to create a new version, `GET-v1-subscriptionVersions-_id_` to read a version, and `GET-v1-subscriptions-_id_-versions` to list all versions for a subscription. Each version exposes its own localizations and promotional images through `GET-v1-subscriptionVersions-_id_-localizations` and `GET-v1-subscriptionVersions-_id_-images`.

Manage subscription group metadata as discrete versions. Use `POST-v1-subscriptionGroupVersions` to create a new version, `GET-v1-subscriptionGroupVersions-_id_` to read a version, and `GET-v1-subscriptionGroups-_id_-versions` to list all versions for a subscription group. Each version exposes its own localizations through `GET-v1-subscriptionGroupVersions-_id_-localizations`.

Submit an in-app purchase version, subscription version, or subscription group version to App Review. Use `POST-v1-reviewSubmissionItems` with an `inAppPurchaseVersion`, `subscriptionVersion`, or `subscriptionGroupVersion` relationship to add the version to a review submission.

Use `POST-v2-inAppPurchaseLocalizations`, `PATCH-v2-inAppPurchaseLocalizations-_id_`, and `DELETE-v2-inAppPurchaseLocalizations-_id_` to manage in-app purchase localizations, and `POST-v2-inAppPurchaseImages`, `PATCH-v2-inAppPurchaseImages-_id_`, and `DELETE-v2-inAppPurchaseImages-_id_` to manage review screenshots. These v2 endpoints are scoped to an `InAppPurchaseVersion`.

Use `POST-v2-subscriptionLocalizations`, `PATCH-v2-subscriptionLocalizations-_id_`, and `DELETE-v2-subscriptionLocalizations-_id_` to manage subscription localizations, and `POST-v2-subscriptionImages`, `PATCH-v2-subscriptionImages-_id_`, and `DELETE-v2-subscriptionImages-_id_` to manage promotional images. These v2 endpoints are scoped to a `SubscriptionVersion`.

Use `POST-v2-subscriptionGroupLocalizations`, `PATCH-v2-subscriptionGroupLocalizations-_id_`, and `DELETE-v2-subscriptionGroupLocalizations-_id_` to manage subscription group localizations, including localized custom app names. These v2 endpoints are scoped to a `SubscriptionGroupVersion`.

Use `GET-v1-subscriptionPricePoints-_id_-adjustedEqualizations` to read the price points that App Store Connect uses to equalize a subscription’s price across territories when the base price point changes. Filter the endpoint with `filter[upfrontPricePointId]` and `filter[planType]` to identify a specific adjusted equalization.

Added the `socialMedia` and `socialMediaAgeRestricted` Boolean attributes to `AgeRatingDeclaration` and `AgeRatingDeclarationUpdateRequest`, so you can declare whether your app includes social media features and whether those features are age-restricted.
The `in-app-purchase-localizations-v1` resource is deprecated. Use `in-app-purchase-localizations` instead, which scopes localizations to an `InAppPurchaseVersion`.
The `in-app-purchase-images-v1` resource is deprecated. Use `in-app-purchase-images` instead, which scopes review screenshots to an `InAppPurchaseVersion`.
The `in-app-purchase-submissions` resource is deprecated. Use `review-submissions` instead to submit an in-app purchase version for App Review.
The `subscription-localizations-v1` resource is deprecated. Use `subscription-localizations` instead, which scopes localizations to a `SubscriptionVersion`.
The `subscription-images-v1` resource is deprecated. Use `subscription-images` instead, which scopes promotional images to a `SubscriptionVersion`.
The `subscription-group-localizations-v1` resource is deprecated. Use `subscription-group-localizations` instead, which scopes localizations to a `SubscriptionGroupVersion`.
The `subscription-and-subscription-group-submissions` resource is deprecated. Use `review-submissions` instead to submit a subscription version or subscription group version for App Review.
